scope_note: OOD evaluation refit for the model now in production. ID set = field_robust_v3 held-out test split (near-duplicate-group split, Corn/Potato, lab+field images). Real OOD = 300 PlantVillage images of Tomato/Apple/Grape classes never in training; plus 100 synthetic non-plant images. Thresholds calibrated on the VALIDATION split only.
id_set: field_robust_v3 held-out test split (896 images, Corn/Potato)

ood_noise_set.composition: 25 each of: pure random noise, solid color, half-split block, linear gradient

threshold_calibration.calibrated_on: validation split only (never test or OOD data)
threshold_calibration.confidence_threshold_meaning: reject if max softmax confidence < this value (5th percentile of val confidences)
threshold_calibration.mahalanobis_threshold_meaning: reject if embedding distance > this value (95th percentile of val distances)

interpretation: AUROC 0.5 = chance, 1.0 = perfect separation. FPR95 = fraction of in-distribution images wrongly rejected when 95% of OOD is caught; lower is better.
